title: AHB Address and Data Phase Ownership
description: AHB address/control for the next transfer can overlap the current transfer's data/response phase; HREADY identifies the edge that completes the current phase and accepts the pending address phase.

annotations.message: Transfer A is visible as NONSEQ and is accepted at this rising edge because HREADY is HIGH.
Transfer B's address/control is accepted while transfer A owns the data/response phase.
Transfer C is visible but pending: HREADY is LOW, so B remains the data/response owner and C is not accepted.
HREADY is HIGH: B completes and the still-visible transfer C address/control is accepted on this edge.
